refnamediv.refpurpose: Initiates a connection on a socket

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
socket
A Socket instance created with socket_create.
address
The address parameter is either an IPv4 address in dotted-quad notation (e.g. 127.0.0.1) or a host name (e.g. localhost), which is resolved, if socket is AF_INET, a valid IPv6 address (e.g. ::1) if IPv6 support is enabled and socket is AF_INET6 or the pathname of a Unix domain socket, if the socket family is AF_UNIX. When a host name cannot be resolved, the function returns &false; and socket_last_error returns -10001 (socket_strerror gives "Unknown host").
port
The port parameter is only used and is mandatory when connecting to an AF_INET or an AF_INET6 socket, and designates the port on the remote host to which a connection should be made.
